{{Top|leg}}
A '''shallow-digger''' was a piece of [[Mining/Legends|mining]] equipment. Many were abandoned on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and co-opted by the [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmers]] after the mining ventures failed to pay off as predicted.
